# Resume Maker by QD

> Resume by QD is the free resume maker from Quantum Digitizing: no signup, no email, and no watermark, with 40 original templates, ATS Safe mode, and instant PDF and Word export. Your data stays in your browser at resumemaker.quantumdigitizing.com.

Resume by QD is made by [Quantum Digitizing](https://www.quantumdigitizing.com/). There is no account system. Resume data stays in the visitor's browser (localStorage). The product is free forever. PDF and Word downloads have no watermark. Official site: https://resumemaker.quantumdigitizing.com.

- No signup required, no email required, does not require an account
